errors.text_span: Two sets of bars are presented for each model
errors.evidence: The chart displays one group of two bars for each model, not two separate sets of bars for each model. The terminology is incorrect and could be confusing, as there are two sets (MMAU and MMAR) in total for the entire chart, not per model.
The MMAR bar for the 'Audio-Reasoner' category is visibly higher than the midpoint between 30% and 40%. A value of 35% is an underestimate; the correct approximate value is closer to 36% or 37%.

errors.text_span: the MMAU bar has an approximate height of 50%
errors.evidence: For the 'Qwen2-Audio-Instruct' category, the MMAU bar is visibly below the 50% line, at approximately 49%. While 'approximately 50%' is a close rounding, it is not the most accurate description.
